# tukeyedar

The `tukeyedar` package houses data exploration tools. Many functions
are inspired by work published by Tukey (1977), Hoaglin (1983), Velleman
and Hoaglin (1981), and Cleveland (1993).

> This package was initially developed for an introductory course in
> Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA). As such, many of its functions have
> not undergone the rigorous testing and validation typically required
> for research or production use. Users are advised to exercise caution
> and verify results independently before applying the package in
> critical or high-stakes contexts.

## Installation

You can install the development version of tukeyedar from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("mgimond/tukeyedar")
```

Note that the vignettes will not be automatically generated with the
above command, however, the vignettes are available on this website (see
next section). If you want a local version of the vignettes, add the
`build_vignettes = TRUE` parameter.

``` r

remotes::install_github("mgimond/tukeyedar", build_vignettes = TRUE)
```

If, for some reason the vignettes are not created, you might want to
re-install the package with the `force=TRUE` parameter.

``` r

remotes::install_github("mgimond/tukeyedar", build_vignettes = TRUE, force=TRUE)
```

## Vignettes

It’s strongly recommended that you read the vignettes. These can be
accessed from this website:

- [A detailed rundown of the resistant line
  function](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/articles/RLine.html)
- [The median
  polish](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/articles/polish.html)
- [The empirical QQ
  plot](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/articles/qq.html)
- [The symmetry QQ
  plot](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/articles/symqq.html)
- [The residual-fit spread
  plot](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/articles/rfs.html)

If you chose to have the vignettes locally created when you installed
the package, then you can view them locally via
[`vignette("RLine", package = "tukeyedar")`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/articles/RLine.md).
If you use a dark themed IDE, the vignettes may not render very well so
you might opt to view them in a web browser via the functions
`RShowDoc("RLine", package = "tukeyedar")`.

## Using the functions

All functions start with `eda_`. For example, to generate a three point
summary plot of the `mpg` vs. `disp` from the `mtcars` dataset, type:

``` r

library(tukeyedar)
eda_3pt(mtcars, disp, mpg)
```

Note that most functions are *pipe* friendly. For examples:

``` r

# Using R >= 4.1
mtcars |>  eda_3pt(disp, mpg)

# Using magrittr (or any of the tidyverse packages)
library(magrittr)
mtcars %>% eda_3pt(disp, mpg)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Cleveland, William. 1993. *Visualizing Data*. Hobart Press.

Hoaglin, Mosteller, D. C. 1983. *Understanding Robust and Exploratory
Data Analysis*. Wiley.

Tukey, John W. 1977. *Exploratory Data Analysis*. Addison-Wesley.

Velleman, P. F., and D. C. Hoaglin. 1981. *Applications, Basics and
Computing of Exploratory Data Analysis*. Boston: Duxbury Press.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`age_height`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/age_height.md)
  : Age vs. height for private and rural school children

- [`.eda_plot_xy()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/dot-eda_plot_xy.md)
  : x-y Scatterplot with EDA Enhancements

- [`eda_3pt()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_3pt.md)
  : 3-point summary plot

- [`eda_add()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_add.md)
  : Add graphical EDA elements to existing plot

- [`eda_anova_table()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_anova_table.md)
  :

  Generate an ANOVA Table from `eda_mean_sweep` output

- [`eda_bipow()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_bipow.md)
  : Ladder of powers transformation on bivariate data with three-point
  summary plot

- [`eda_boxls()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_boxls.md)
  : Boxplots equalized by level and spread

- [`eda_dens()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_dens.md)
  : Overlapping density distributions for two variables

- [`eda_fval()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_fval.md)
  : Calculate quantile f-values

- [`eda_jitter()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_jitter.md)
  : Jitter plot

- [`eda_lm()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_lm.md)
  : Regression plot (with optional LOESS fit)

- [`eda_lsum()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_lsum.md)
  : Tukey's letter value summary

- [`eda_matlong()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_matlong.md)
  : Convert 2-way data tables Between Long and Matrix Formats

- [`eda_mdens()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_mdens.md)
  : Overlapping density distributions for multiple variables

- [`eda_mean_sweep()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_mean_sweep.md)
  : Exploratory ANOVA Decomposition

- [`eda_moments()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_moments.md)
  : Compute moments of a dataset

- [`eda_normfit()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_normfit.md)
  : Normal fit vs density plot

- [`eda_npol()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_npol.md)
  : N-way median polish

- [`eda_pol()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_pol.md)
  : Median polish of two-way tables

- [`eda_qq()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_qq.md)
  : Quantile-Quantile and Tukey mean-difference plots

- [`eda_qqmat()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_qqmat.md)
  : QQ plot matrix

- [`eda_qqpool()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_qqpool.md)
  : Multi-panel pooled values QQ plots

- [`eda_re()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_re.md)
  : Re-expression function

- [`eda_rfs()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_rfs.md)
  : Residual-Fit Spread Plot

- [`eda_rline()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_rline.md)
  : Tukey's resistant line

- [`eda_shuffle()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_shuffle.md)
  : Shuffle values across groups

- [`eda_sim()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_sim.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Simulate data using Fleishman transformation

- [`eda_sim_old()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_sim_old.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Simulate data using Fleishman transformation

- [`eda_sl()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_sl.md)
  : Spread-location and spread-level plots

- [`eda_sym()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_sym.md)
  : Symmetry QQ plot

- [`eda_theo()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_theo.md)
  : Theoretical QQ plot

- [`eda_theopan()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_theopan.md)
  : Multi-panel theoretical QQ plots

- [`eda_trim()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_trim.md)
  [`eda_trim_df()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_trim.md)
  [`eda_ltrim()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_trim.md)
  [`eda_ltrim_df()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_trim.md)
  [`eda_rtrim()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_trim.md)
  [`eda_rtrim_df()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_trim.md)
  : Trims vector and dataframe objects

- [`eda_unipow()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_unipow.md)
  : Ladder of powers transformation on a single vector

- [`eda_untie()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_untie.md)
  : Resolve ties in a numeric vector

- [`eda_vd()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_vd.md)
  : Variability decomposition plot

- [`eda_viol()`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/eda_viol.md)
  : Violin plot.

- [`edtts2.12`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/edtts2.12.md)
  : Confidence in American institutions survey data

- [`edtts4.25`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/edtts4.25.md)
  : Dataset that is perfectly additive in the square root scale

- [`feav1_5`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/feav1_5.md)
  : Presidential Election Results for Franklin D. Roosevelt (1932-1944)

- [`feav5_12`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/feav5_12.md)
  : Weight Gain in Rats on Different Diets

- [`feav5_14`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/feav5_14.md)
  : ELISA Test Absorbance for HIV Positive Controls

- [`feav6_1`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/feav6_1.md)
  : Simulated Tumor Measurements by Oncologists

- [`feav6_5`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/feav6_5.md)
  : Replicated Tumor Measurements by Oncologists

- [`feav6_8`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/feav6_8.md)
  : Diamond Pyramid Hardness Number of Dental Fillings

- [`income`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/income.md) :
  Income dataset

- [`incrent22`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/incrent22.md)
  : American Community Survey 2022 Median household income and median
  rent by county

- [`inf_mort`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/inf_mort.md)
  : Infant mortality dataset

- [`logan`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/logan.md) :
  Logan airport dataset

- [`neoplasms`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/neoplasms.md)
  : Breast cancer mortality vs. temperature

- [`nine_point`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/nine_point.md)
  : Andrew Siegel's pathological 9-point dataset

- [`plot(`*`<eda_lm>`*`)`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/plot.eda_lm.md)
  : Residuals plot

- [`plot(`*`<eda_mean_sweep>`*`)`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/plot.eda_mean_sweep.md)
  :

  Plot method for `eda_mean_sweep` objects

- [`plot(`*`<eda_npol>`*`)`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/plot.eda_npol.md)
  :

  Plot method for `eda_npol` objects

- [`plot(`*`<eda_polish>`*`)`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/plot.eda_polish.md)
  :

  Plot method for `eda_polish` objects

- [`plot(`*`<eda_rline>`*`)`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/plot.eda_rline.md)
  : Plot eda_rline model

- [`wat05`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/wat05.md) :
  Temperature normals for Waterville Maine (1991-2020)

- [`wat95`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/wat95.md) :
  Legacy temperature normals for Waterville Maine (1981-2010)

- [`yarn`](https://mgimond.github.io/tukeyedar/reference/yarn.md) : yarn
  dataset
